facts.fact: The Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs reports a EUR 41,557 grant to the Media Institute of Southern Africa, with Zimbabwe as recipient, for a project from 2024-01-01 to 2025-05-28 to develop a legal framework and policy brief on AI and media freedom.
facts.system: Media Freedom and Access to Information in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
